title: Script
description: JSON Schema for a script instance: a POSIX executable regular-file realizing a $\mathcal{P}$-morphism's body. Carries the path, interpreter, parameters shape (input), message shape (output), exit-code discipline, realization discipline, and the skill it realizes.

has-path.description: Repo-relative or absolute POSIX path to the script file.

has-interpreter.description: Interpreter slug — typically 'node' for .mjs ESM scripts in the 561 OS.

has-parameters-shape.description: Reference to the parameters shape the script consumes — either a kebab-case structure-slug or an https://561.group/...schema.json IRI resolving to a JSON Schema 2020-12 file. The morphism's domain.

produces-message-shape.description: Reference to the message shape the script produces — either a kebab-case structure-slug or an https://561.group/...schema.json IRI resolving to a JSON Schema 2020-12 file. The morphism's codomain.

has-exit-code-discipline.description: Description of what each exit code means.

has-realization-discipline.description: The byte-level discipline this script realizes the morphism's body under. 'pure-function-on-json' is the realization the categorical theorem forces for $\mathcal{P}$-morphisms whose action is fully data — default-exported pure function from Json(domain) to Json(codomain), no side effects. The other values name distinct realization classes whose by-side-effect content is essential (state-mutating-procedure mutates filesystem-resident records; wire-sending writes a message to a wire-protocol endpoint; wire-receiving reads one from such an endpoint; runtime-service is a long-running process maintaining state across invocations; hook-handler executes in a POSIX-process spawned by an external event source like a git hook or a Claude Code hook). Audit conformance is mechanical for 'pure-function-on-json' and best-effort for the rest.

realizes-body-of.description: Skill slug whose body this script realizes.
